unsupported: B & J Food Equipment was founded in 1994 in Kansas City, Missouri, by Bill and Nancy Mosburg as a family‑run venture to sell used equipment from their small restaurant chain.
Its two showrooms double as distribution hubs serving independent operators and multi‑unit chains alike.

The firm also supplies institutional and hospitality foodservice operations, leveraging buying‑group affiliations with ABC and IFED and the broader Innovative Foodservice Group network that extends distribution across the Southeast.
